items.title: TOWAR: whole blood vs blood components
items.takeaway: The 2026 TOWAR phase 3 cluster-randomized trial did not show lower 30-day mortality with prehospital whole blood compared with blood components. This does not mean prehospital transfusion is ineffective; it cautions against assuming whole blood is superior to a component strategy in all systems.
items.lesson_title: Hemorrhagic Shock & Prehospital Blood: what is changing?

items.title: TOWAR prehospital whole blood trial
items.takeaway: A large pragmatic cluster-randomized phase 3 trial compared up to 2 units of whole blood with component therapy in prehospital trauma hemorrhage, reflecting the rapid maturation of prehospital transfusion systems. Interpret outcomes in context of local capability and protocol.
items.lesson_title: Hemorrhagic Shock & Prehospital Blood: what is changing?

items.title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign update
items.takeaway: The 2026 SSC replaces 2021 guidance with 129 statements, including 46 new statements and explicit attention to immediate prehospital care.
items.lesson_title: Sepsis & Septic Shock 2026: recognition, source, fluids, vasopressors

items.title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2026
items.takeaway: The 2026 adult guideline includes 129 statements, 46 new, and explicitly spans immediate prehospital, hospital and immediate post-hospital settings.
items.lesson_title: Sepsis & Septic Shock 2026: recognition, source, fluids, vasopressors

items.title: NICU quality improvement with VL
items.takeaway: A 2026 QI project reported sustained improvement in first-attempt success after implementing VL and standardized oxygenation, including infants <1000 g.
items.lesson_title: Neonatal Ventilation, ETT, Laryngeal Mask & Video Laryngoscopy

items.title: Major guideline update
items.takeaway: 2026 AIS guidance endorses mobile stroke units, refines EMS triage, expands tenecteplase use and broadens EVT eligibility including basilar occlusion and selected larger-core patients.
items.lesson_title: Acute Ischemic Stroke 2026: EMS triage, TNK, thrombectomy & time windows

items.title: Learning focus: OMI concepts continue to influence ECG education
items.takeaway: Contemporary ECG education increasingly emphasizes recognizing acute coronary occlusion patterns beyond classic ST-elevation criteria, but local activation pathways still follow formal ACS/STEMI protocols.
items.lesson_title: ECG Interpretation: จากไฟฟ้าหัวใจสู่การตัดสินใจ

items.title: GOLD 2026 Report
items.takeaway: The 2026 GOLD report is the current evidence-based global COPD strategy; local acute-exacerbation pathways should determine exact therapies and targets.
items.lesson_title: COPD Exacerbation 2026: Oxygen, Ventilation & Hypercapnia

items.title: GINA 2026 Strategy Report
items.takeaway: GINA 2026 integrates newly reviewed evidence and remains a current global asthma strategy source. Use local acute-care protocol for drug concentrations and EMS scope.
items.lesson_title: Acute Asthma 2026: Bronchospasm, Dynamic Hyperinflation & Escalation

items.title: BTF prehospital TBI 3rd edition
items.takeaway: The Brain Trauma Foundation now lists a 3rd edition prehospital guideline framework covering oxygenation, BP, ventilation, GCS, pupils, fluids, hyperosmolar therapy and destination decisions.
items.lesson_title: Traumatic Brain Injury: prevent secondary brain injury

items.title: AHA/ASA 2026 expands stroke systems and treatment eligibility
items.takeaway: The 2026 guideline adds recommendations around mobile stroke units, refined EMS destination strategy, broader tenecteplase and EVT eligibility, and pediatric AIS.
items.lesson_title: Acute Ischemic Stroke 2026: EMS triage, TNK, thrombectomy & time windows

items.title: WHO consolidated PPH guideline
items.takeaway: WHO/FIGO/ICM consolidated 51 evidence-based recommendations and emphasized earlier diagnosis and immediate MOTIVE bundle treatment.
items.lesson_title: Obstetric Emergencies: PPH, eclampsia & cardiac arrest in pregnancy

items.title: Special circumstances guideline expansion
items.takeaway: AHA 2025 updated 44 recommendations and added 140 new recommendations across special circumstances including multiple poisonings and pregnancy.
items.lesson_title: Toxicology: toxidromes, cardiotoxic poisonings & special resuscitation

items.title: Routine oxygen in normoxic ACS
items.takeaway: Randomized evidence reviewed in the 2025 guideline shows no cardiovascular benefit from routine oxygen when SpO₂ is already ≥90%.
items.lesson_title: Acute Coronary Syndrome: Pathophysiology → ECG → Prehospital System

items.title: Pediatric epinephrine timing
items.takeaway: 2025 evidence update found observational data favoring earlier epinephrine for initial nonshockable pediatric arrest, while timing in shockable rhythms remains uncertain because defibrillation must remain the priority.
items.lesson_title: Cardiac Arrest & Post-ROSC: CPR physiology, rhythms, drugs, EtCO₂

items.title: PALS bradycardia evidence remains low certainty
items.takeaway: 2025 PALS reinforces ventilation-first thinking and CPR when HR <60/min with compromise despite effective ventilation; much of bradycardia evidence remains observational.
items.lesson_title: Bradycardia & Tachyarrhythmia: Hemodynamics ก่อนชื่อ rhythm

items.title: Neonatal video laryngoscopy evidence
items.takeaway: Across 4 RCTs, video laryngoscopy increased overall and first-attempt intubation success; ILCOR 2025 conditionally favors VL where resources/training permit.
items.lesson_title: Neonatal Ventilation, ETT, Laryngeal Mask & Video Laryngoscopy

items.title: Earlier epinephrine in nonshockable pediatric arrest
items.takeaway: Evidence updates identified observational studies linking shorter time to first epinephrine with better outcomes in nonshockable arrest; certainty remains limited.
items.lesson_title: Pediatric Arrest & Shock: ventilation-first physiology, epinephrine, defibrillation

items.title: AHA/AAP PALS guideline refresh
items.takeaway: The 2025 PALS guideline covers prearrest, arrest and post-arrest care, ventilation, drug/energy dosing, shock and arrhythmias across prehospital and hospital settings.
items.lesson_title: Pediatric Arrest & Shock: ventilation-first physiology, epinephrine, defibrillation

items.title: AHA Special Circumstances: cardiotoxic poisoning
items.takeaway: Updated AHA resuscitation guidance includes high-dose insulin and vasoactive support for life-threatening calcium-channel blocker poisoning.
items.lesson_title: Beta-Blocker & Calcium-Channel Blocker Poisoning

items.title: ACS guideline consolidated STEMI + NSTEMI evidence
items.takeaway: The 2025 guideline replaced the separated older STEMI/NSTEMI frameworks with one ACS guideline and updates antiplatelet, invasive strategy and supportive-care recommendations.
items.lesson_title: Acute Coronary Syndrome: Pathophysiology → ECG → Prehospital System

items.title: 2025 multidisciplinary ACS guideline
items.takeaway: The 2025 ACC/AHA/ACEP/NAEMSP/SCAI guideline consolidates STEMI, NSTEMI and unstable angina management with updated evidence across the acute-care system.
items.lesson_title: Acute Coronary Syndrome: Pathophysiology → ECG → Prehospital System

items.title: 2025 Neonatal Resuscitation emphasizes cord/transition systems
items.takeaway: The 2025 AHA/AAP neonatal guideline introduces an updated algorithm and Newborn Chain of Care, with emphasis on cord-management planning, thermal care and effective ventilation.
items.lesson_title: Neonatal Transition & Initial Steps: first minute matters

items.title: PREOXI: preoxygenation is an active intervention
items.takeaway: PREOXI strengthens evidence that positive-pressure NIV preoxygenation can reduce peri-intubation hypoxemia in critically ill adults; device choice should be individualized.
items.lesson_title: RSI / Tracheal Intubation: First-pass success, drugs, capnography

items.title: PREOXI: NIV preoxygenation reduced hypoxemia
items.takeaway: In 1301 critically ill adults, preoxygenation with noninvasive ventilation reduced hypoxemia during intubation compared with an oxygen mask (9.1% vs 18.5%). Apply to appropriate patients with trained teams and aspiration/pressure considerations.
items.lesson_title: Preoxygenation, BVM & Peri-intubation Oxygenation

items.title: DEVICE randomized trial: video vs direct laryngoscopy
items.takeaway: Among critically ill adults in the DEVICE trial, first-attempt success was 85.1% with video laryngoscopy vs 70.8% with direct laryngoscopy; severe complications were similar. This supports VL availability/training but does not remove the need for airway planning and rescue skills.
items.lesson_title: RSI / Tracheal Intubation: First-pass success, drugs, capnography

items.title: DEVICE randomized trial
items.takeaway: Video laryngoscopy improved first-attempt intubation success from 70.8% to 85.1% in critically ill adults; severe complications were similar.
items.lesson_title: RSI / Tracheal Intubation: First-pass success, drugs, capnography

items.title: Bag-mask ventilation during intubation
items.takeaway: A randomized trial in critically ill adults found bag-mask ventilation during the apneic period reduced severe hypoxemia without a clear increase in aspiration; application depends on aspiration risk and local airway practice.
items.lesson_title: Preoxygenation, BVM & Peri-intubation Oxygenation
